Task T3 is complete. Summary:

- **`out/T3/solution.py`**: loads `inputs/base/model.safetensors` via `safetensors.safe_open`, drops the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, casts exactly the 48 named projection matrices to bfloat16 (`.to(torch.bfloat16)`), leaves everything else float32/unchanged, asserts all four required checks (48 bf16 tensors, `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` bf16, `wte.weight` fp32, 148 total tensors) before writing anything, then greedy-bin-packs tensors into shards ≤64 MiB of tensor data (oversized `wte.weight` gets its own shard) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- **`out/T3/run.sh`**: thin wrapper invoking the script with the sandbox's `.venv/bin/python`.
- **`out/T3/REPORT.md`**: participant self-report.

Verified independently after running: 148 tensors total across 4 shards (3 at ~63 MiB, one holding only `wte.weight` at ~147 MB standalone), bit-exact float32 values for unchanged tensors, bit-exact bfloat16 casts, and all 12 buffers correctly dropped. Only `torch` and `safetensors` were used — no merge/adapter tooling fit this per-tensor dtype/sharding task better than a direct script.
